flags.observation: "Black Friday!" lands as a rimshot; the heel-for-shoe image never names the sale logic, so normies must supply the link themselves.
Expert layer in the intro is thin: "uncut Grimm" and "promos" only, no precise name, date or quote for insiders.
"still" appears three times outside card text (beats 7, 49, 56), above the twice-per-word limit.
Openers on 15 of 52 cards, below the one-third floor; the first three cards run bare after the intro.
Beats 10-16 and 18-24 each run seven cards with no opener; no therefore/but bridge carries these stretches.
"Turnip line, reused" comments on the deck recycling its own text; ironic distance against Tip 4, straight face.
"friendly eyes on her" loses the instruction, so the literal-obedience story of the card is hard to follow by ear.
The self-acting detail of the stick is cut; "a stick that beats people is better" now reads as plain violence, not magic.
"till his name is guessed" turns the card's conditional self-destruction into a duration for the spinning; logic drifts from source.
"cock screamed" without article breaks the four-animal rhythm and invites an unintended snicker.
105 characters with opener colon plus name colon; the same over-95 double-colon pattern recurs in beats 33, 46, 50, 52, 54.
Both style variants are single-genre (Balkan brass, nu-disco); no genre fusion is named, though BPM, voice and instruments fit.
